svg.title: Boorusama Content Architecture (Draft), faithful vector reconstruction
svg.desc: A manually editable reconstruction inspired by the original generated poster: Post remains one media item, groups contain members, mixed list entries wrap posts or group summaries, and content references, identities, viewer occurrences and local bookmark membership are separate.

g.text: Keep Post. Add a small shared Group layer.
Shared concept, not one UI for everything
Use only where a list can contain
